methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $3M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Durin is a pre-seed Infrastructure & Logistics company founded by Ted Feldmann that has raised $3.4M to date. The comparable universe consists of one identified private peer (Watoga Technologies); no public Infrastructure & Logistics comparables were available for direct benchmarking.

The stage-progression method was the applicable valuation framework given limited comparable data. Using total raised of $3.4M as a proxy for implicit valuation and applying a typical pre-seed to next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $8.5M. This single-method approach constrains the triangulation range to $7M (low) through $8.5M (median) to $9.8M (high), reflecting ±15% variance bounds around the central estimate.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $7M to $10M, with $8.5M as the median point. Key limitations include reliance on a single valuation methodology due to sparse comparable data, absence of public sector peers for cross-validation, and limited visibility into Durin's unit economics or revenue trajectory. The range is most sensitive to actual execution risk at the seed-to-Series A progression and the appropriateness of the 2.5x stage multiplier for this particular company's risk profile and market conditions.
